title: Dhuduki: a string beneath the story
coverage_gap: Research-map query and KB search for Dhuduki, Ghuduki and Dhudki found no dedicated narrative. Existing AIR and CCRT publication identities reused for new passages.

sources.title: Heritage Odisha — Traditional People
sources.locator: Ghudiki (or Dhuduki) Nabaranga Nata section, three paragraphs. Descriptive cultural essay on the J K Dash website; publication date and original essay authorship not established. Construction and theatre roles attributed to this account, not independently observed.

sources.title: Prasar Bharati — AIR Cuttack music artist roster
sources.locator: Printed/PDF pp.39–40, Dhuduki Geeta table; Alok Bishoyi and party on p.39 with audition date 2 March 2015. PDF text and images inspected. Reuses the roster identity cited in Sankha research; publication date not established.

sources.title: Nayagarh district administration — Art & Culture
sources.locator: Folk-dance list: Ghuduki (Ranapur). Page text read 15 October 2026; footer says last updated 10 June 2026. A locality association, not a performance schedule or origin claim.

sources.title: Tribal and Traditional Folk Dance of Odisha — CCRT-hosted fellowship report
sources.locator: Printed p.32, Patara Saura dance in the Gunpur region of Rayagada: Ghuduki named as an accompanying instrument. Indexed page passage inspected; complete PDF download timed out. Report date not established. Same publication identity as the Ghumura research, different passage.

claim_boundaries: Construction account is attributed to Heritage Odisha; not an organological measurement or independent examination.
Spelling variants are preserved from named sources; no claim that all similarly named regional practices are identical.
AIR audition date is neither broadcast date nor origin date.
Locality associations do not establish birthplace or universal distribution.
No caste-origin, ancient continuity, animal-material specification or current troupe count asserted.
No audio, lyrics, translations or source imagery republished.
